flush_interval.description: Interval in seconds to flush accumulated data to the output file.

fdelay.default: 60			# this defines after how many seconds
fdelay.description: Seconds of inactivity after which a traffic record is written out.

logfile.description: Path to the regular output log file for the daemon.

dumpfile.description: Path to the dump file to save unwritten information in case of a crash.

ignore_mask.default: 255.255.255.0        # Ignore traffic on same class C net
ignore_mask.description: Subnet mask to ignore traffic on the same Class C network (local LAN).

ignore_network.description: Network address to explicitly ignore (e.g., loopback).

ignore_mask_net.description: Network mask for the ignore_network definition.

debug_logfile.description: Path to the debugging information log file.
